beats.text: Six signs you're emotionally exhausted — not lazy, not weak.
One. You sleep, you rest — and still wake up feeling like you never stopped.
Two. Small tasks feel enormous. Answering one message can feel like climbing a hill.
Three. You're irritable over tiny things. The tank is simply empty.
Four. You've gone numb rather than sad — just flat, switched off, going through the motions.
Five. You're pulling away from the people you actually love. Connection feels like effort.
Six. You can't focus or remember simple things. A tired mind drops what it's carrying.
This isn't a character flaw. It's a signal. Rest isn't a reward you earn — it's maintenance you need.
